title: Code review
concept: Read a real review comment on a line and reply to it

story.speaker: Priya
story.text: I read your pull request. I left one comment and asked for a change.

story.speaker: Priya
story.text: Do not take it personally. Review is how we catch things, not a complaint about you.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Open the pull request. You will see Priya's review marked "requested changes".

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Her comment is pinned to a line. Click Files changed to see exactly where.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Reply to her comment first. Answering before you edit is good manners.

hub.body: Good start. One change needed before I can approve.

comments.body: Can you add the opening hours here? Visitors ask that even more than the menu.

items.text: Reply to Priya's comment on the line
Answer: what should you do when changes are requested?

hints: Priya's comment has a reply box under it in the website panel.
Open the pull request, find her comment, and type a reply in the box beneath it.
In the website panel open pull request #1, find Priya's comment on food.html, type a reply such as "Good idea, adding them now" and press Reply.

questions.prompt: A reviewer requested changes. What do you do next?

choices.text: Close the pull request and open a new one
Add more commits to the same branch and push them
Delete the branch and start again

questions.explanation: The pull request follows your branch. New commits pushed to that branch show up in the same pull request automatically.

recap: A review can approve, comment, or request changes. Comments are pinned to lines. Reply to them, then fix the code on the same branch.

hub.body: Good idea. Adding the opening hours now.
